title: grid-skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/grid-skeleton.md.j2 and templates/grid-skeleton.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from grid-skeleton.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

site_a.title: Site a
site_a.description: Which call site is the first row? Name it as the code names it, so a reader can find the call without guessing.

site_b.title: Site b
site_b.description: Which call site is the second row?

site_c.title: Site c
site_c.description: Which call site is the third row? Add or delete rows freely - three is a starting shape, not a limit.

system_name.description: Which system does this grid cover - the one whose call sites are listed below? One grid per system; two systems in one grid makes the rollback budget meaningless.
